title: Claims/assets, 1973: agreement making and failure, bounded primary check
event_scope: US instruction in 1972; selected exchanges in 1973–1975; 1977 decision to defer. Does not cover the 1979 settlement or its performance.

sources.title: National Security Decision Memorandum 188, PRC blocked assets and private claims
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete published instruction and all four notes.
sources.interpretation_limits: Direct US presidential instruction; subsequent negotiating scenario referenced, not obtained.

sources.title: Zhou–Kissinger memorandum of conversation
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Selected claims and channel passages at printed 85–86 and 111–112 (local lines 320–405 and 1645–1735); header and all 14 notes; adjacent context. Most of this long meeting was not read.
sources.interpretation_limits: US meeting record, not Chinese minutes; scope does not reconstruct entire February agreement.

sources.title: Zhou–Kissinger memorandum of conversation
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Selected claims exchange at printed 364–367 (local lines 239–300 and 368–381); header, all seven notes and closing dialogue at lines 940–1010. Not the complete meeting.
sources.interpretation_limits: Changing percentage estimates are negotiating representations, not audited accounting.

sources.title: Zhou–Kissinger memorandum of conversation
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete selected claims/MFN discussion at printed 411–416 (local lines 543–822); header and all six notes; closing context at 870–890. Not the complete meeting. The truncated first display was recovered by separately reading 628–790.
sources.interpretation_limits: Zhou monetary proposal and payment-route preference; US legal consultation and further proposal remained. No final signed instrument.

sources.title: Kissinger to Nixon, My Visit to China
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Claims paragraphs under Bilateral Technical Issues at printed 439 (lines 370–398); opening MFN paragraph 399–404; Atmosphere conclusion and nearby context 450–498; header and all 14 notes. Not the complete report.
sources.interpretation_limits: Same participant chain as the meeting records, not independent confirmation. Note 12 identifies unacquired counterpart memoranda.

sources.title: Solomon to Kissinger, Current State of US–PRC Relations
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete published body and eight editorial/source notes.
sources.interpretation_limits: Contemporary Solomon assessment, partly redacted reporting and unprinted attachments; cannot independently corroborate his later book by repetition.

sources.title: Hummel informal letter to Jenkins
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete published letter and seven notes.
sources.interpretation_limits: US internal communication constraints and reported Chinese information gaps; not a claims-specific causal explanation. Printed letter date conflicts with footnote 6’s chronology of Unger’s nomination; no finding is derived from that date comparison.

sources.title: Deng–Kissinger memorandum of conversation
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Selected technical-issues and claims framing at printed 565–566 (lines 155–210); closing counterpart assignment, header and all seven notes. Not the complete meeting.
sources.interpretation_limits: Subsequent political framing, not the June 14, 1974 withdrawal message.

sources.title: Deng–Kissinger memorandum of conversation
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete selected Bilateral Relations section at printed 802–804 (lines 180–277); neighboring context 278–300; header and all five notes. Not the complete meeting.
sources.interpretation_limits: Direct continuing disagreement; no internal Chinese instruction. Note 2 identifies unacquired Habib–Lin counterpart memoranda.

sources.title: Vance and Brzezinski memoranda to Carter on claims/assets
sources.source_type: US government contemporary record in published FRUS
sources.reading_scope: Complete two memoranda and all six editorial/source notes.
sources.interpretation_limits: American report of the 1974 offer withdrawal and 1977 probe; covering memorandum and attachment are not independent witnesses. The stated congressional constraint is not an observed rejection of this China proposal. Approval annotations read.

source_independence: Published American administrative and participant records; no independent Chinese archive. Solomon’s 1973 memorandum and his later book are not independent explanations. Full captures exceed the actual reading scope.
preservation_policy: Full source HTML and extracts outside Git; original analysis/metadata only inside. No interviews or archive requests.
missing_records: Chinese message of June 14, 1974, cited by Solomon p.148, note137; not obtained.
Successive February/March 1973 drafts and promised November US follow-up proposal; not obtained.
November 1973 Hummel counterpart-talk memoranda: Nixon NSC, Kissinger Office Files, Box87, PRC Counterpart Talks, 1971–73; identified in FRUS XVIII/62, note12; not obtained.
Chinese authorization for Zhou’s offer and later withdrawal; unprinted or redacted reporting underlying Solomon’s December 31, 1973 memorandum.
Complete April 29, 1977 Chinese response, referenced in FRUS XIII/29, note4, as document27; not read in this check.
review_status: Bounded independent review completed 2026-09-15 against consequential passages in XVIII/59, 62, 65 and XIII/29, plus Solomon 148–152. Corrected the p.439 locator, restored the strength of Solomon’s p.149 prediction and distinguished a material proposal from a causal effect of access. Not an independent complete rereading of all ten records.
